# L-lyxose finalization preparation

This is an external, inert helper package for the exact adopted L-lyxose record
at base `6435622d08d0a3a8998968eaa96736c702550e9c`. The preparer authored lyxose;
the native saved payload will therefore say **self_review**, with explicit
inheritance from the independently accepted original science, corrected
successor and canonical audit. It must not call this preparer independent.

The target is SHA256
`8ca651dc70a0dda2620ba09719a4e6861517d39f1736ca1971f283900accc121`:
111 edges, 66 references and ten endpoint qualifiers. The prior external issues
438 and 439 retain stable keys and exact original/accepted dispositions in
positive evidence-linked assessments. They have no native structured finding
IDs, so no `previous_occurrences` is fabricated. Saving a clean report does not
claim GitHub issue closure or merge.

All commands use `/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-195-20261011/.venv/bin/python -B`
with `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 UV_NO_SYNC=1`. No installs or sync are needed.
The preparer runs help/guard/lint checks only. Root owns maintained mutations.
Every output directory/receipt below must be a fresh external path, outside this
sealed helper package and all accepted source/review/cache trees.

## Receipt-driven sequence

1. Create a config following `receipt-contract.json`, binding actual completed
   adoption, eight gates/logs, successful preservation, complete 6,444-file
   pre-gate checkpoint, page QA, real static view and root acceptance. Include
   exact source-backed display approval only if there are display changes.
   Include page SVG/PNG, source-backed display assessment scripts or other
   desired actual artifacts in `additional_artifacts`. Logs/scripts/text must
   use lossless UTF-8 JSON wrappers. Any credential-header projection must be
   explicitly labeled and bind its unmodified external full original.
2. Run `prepare_archive.py --config CONFIG --output ARCHIVE_PREPARATION`.
   This verifies actual receipts and old protected surfaces, prepares copies
   externally and does not mutate maintained files.
3. Review its `archive-plan.json`. Run `apply_archive.py --plan PLAN --receipt
   NEW_RECEIPT` for dry run, then use a separate receipt path plus `--apply`
   for root's append-only maintained archive. Existing files are refused.
4. Run `assemble_review.py --archive-receipt APPLIED_RECEIPT --output ASSEMBLY`.
   It calls the unchanged native inspector before current-byte assessment and
   prepares the complete review externally. The in-process input-list wrapper
   avoids shell argument limits while passing every checkpoint path to native
   inspect. It does not reduce or pretend the prior 193-file checkpoint is this
   complete current 6,444-file checkpoint.
5. Review `ASSEMBLY/completed-review.yaml`. Run `run_native.py --assembly
   ASSEMBLY/assembly.json --output NATIVE` to dry run. Root adds `--apply` only
   after accepting the payload; the helper then runs actual native validate,
   save, native history scaffold, history validation and append-only review
   check at the exact base. It never handwrites the history filename/time or
   edits rendered review Markdown. The native saver creates one new bundle,
   bringing the known 101-bundle baseline to 102.
6. Root runs `archive_completion.py --native-completion
   NATIVE/native-completion.json --receipt NEW_RECEIPT`, then a new receipt with
   `--apply` after dry-run review. This archives actual helper/assembly/native
   receipts and exact code as lossless wrappers under `finalization/`.
7. Run `bind_final_files.py --baseline BASELINE/baseline.json
   --native-completion NATIVE/native-completion.json --completion-archive
   APPLIED_COMPLETION_ARCHIVE --output FINAL_BINDINGS`. It inventories hidden,
   ignored and followed paths, refuses old mutations outside the exact accepted
   code/authority/generated set, and permits only the exact new native pair,
   scaffolded history and recorded archive files. It emits
   `approved-extra-files.json` for the existing accepted preservation helper.
8. Root reruns the bounded `preserve-maintained.py` with that exact approval and
   any source-backed display tuple approval. This is a post-packaging check;
   full tests are not silently relabeled as covering later dossier/review files.
9. Run `seal_completion.py --native-completion NATIVE/native-completion.json
   --final-files FINAL_BINDINGS/post-adoption-file-set.json --preservation
   FINAL_PRESERVATION --output FINAL_SEAL`. It refuses missing/failed native
   results, altered files/inventory or preservation drift. This seals only
   actual completion; current preparation is never called a saved review.

The source, code, scientific and canonical packets stay immutable. Existing
records/pages/reviews/history, old edge cells and context multiplicities remain
protected. No blanket shared-node display waiver exists. A changed input stops
assembly or saving; investigate and reassess it instead of refreshing hashes.
Commit, PR adversarial review, CI, merge and cleanup remain root-owned later
steps. Source exhaustion is false. Public-release licensing remains deferred.
